adaptive_probes.condition: Always run restored_untraced to check instrumentation parity. Run the remaining three probes only if live/restart samples differ or archive replay does not match the original passing continuation.
adaptive_probes.description: Use the exact shared fresh400 state. Compare trace instrumentation, synchronized stats, idempotent reload and the recorded nonserialized gradients/module flags. No RNG reset or seed variation.

artifacts: Raw stdout, traces, full contexts and all named streams stay ignored and archived. Publish compact report/metrics/provenance and actual-training GIFs.

gates.quality: Existing Ring16 full bounds, same 96-check five-terminal reducer. Diagnostics cannot fill ordinary qualification.
gates.reproduction: Zero batch, named stream, sampled latent, raw gradient and update tensor mismatches; report exact first mismatch and magnitude.
gates.serialization_restore: Zero tensor/value mismatches except external execution cap.

hypotheses.restore_state: A restore changes serialized values, consumed streams, gradients or update inputs.
hypotheses.runtime_or_numerical: Serialized tensors and draws agree but ephemeral runtime state or numerical kernels change updates.
hypotheses.technique: Only a demonstrated substantive state/draw change would justify a separately declared restart or subbatch technique; this diagnostic adds none.

stopping_rules: Every primary arm finishes its declared cap even if a quality state passes.
Stop an arm on nonfinite loss, incompatible state/source, budget exhaustion or timeout; retain actual cost and error.
No repeat of an executed arm; conditional probes have distinct declared deltas.
No periodic randomization, resampling, row replacement, subbatch repeats, annealing, new seed, gate relaxation or promotion.
trace_contract: Observation wrappers invoke originals once and copy existing tensors to CPU; no extra model calls, RNG draws or optimizer updates. Explicit separate diagnostic cohort until the untraced short restore agrees.
user_authorization: User requested reproducing what actually changes when restarting versus continuing, before treating randomization or subbatch repeating as a technique.
